name: Dharma Economic Model Research
description: Research and define the Dharma token model governing community compute contributions. Cover contribution eligibility, favor accrual and spending, expiry and decay policy, geographic and jurisdiction controls, user consent mechanisms, abuse response, and community capacity marketplace dynamics.
purpose: The Dharma economic model is the incentive backbone of the community compute marketplace. Without a rigorously defined token model — including how contributions earn favor, how favor decays over time, and what constitutes eligible contribution — the marketplace cannot operate fairly or resist abuse. This mission produces the economic architecture that all downstream protocol and implementation decisions depend on.
acceptanceCriteria: Published economic model document defining token issuance, contribution eligibility rules, favor accrual rates, and decay policy
Model document reviewed and accepted by design council with documented disposition of all review comments
Threat model identifies at least three abuse vectors (sybil, free-riding, collusion) with documented mitigation strategy
